description:
Use this when the user asks about the India VIX, the NSE volatility index, today or over a period.

Returns the daily open, high, low, close and change of the India VIX. `from_date` and `to_date` are ISO dates at most 1825 days apart; the default is the 30 days to today.
name: get_india_vix
title: India VIX
